method.biology: Unmodified Model3 mating, individual pollen exclusion, complete three-locus diploid Mendelian offspring genotype law
method.exact_formula: E[number represented genotype classes | q,N] = sum_g (1-(1-q_g)^N)

claim_boundaries: These are numeric engineering assays on exactly specified synthetic founder/visitor support, not new biological replication.
The one-step expectation reference is analytic; the Gaussian projected arm uses repeated Monte Carlo and its standard error is disclosed.
Bias arises from a Gaussian transition plus nonnegative projection and integer rounding. The audit does not attribute it uniquely to Gaussianity.
Changing K in the canonical reproductive operator can change pollen competition and biological selection; these are not one fixed q and varying N.
No proof of monotonic approximation accuracy for all K or all genotype distributions.
These results do not prove the 3-generation K32 gap in the previous trial has this exact mechanism; they demonstrate a one-step structural source of possible accumulation.
Full mutation-enabled multi-generation SPDE/Itô SDE not validated; no INLA or natural island dataset used.
Do not convert exploratory diagnostics into the preregistered ecological study.
